selection_reasoning: The task 'find rose_bush' is a clean, observable, and verifiable atomic task. The agent must navigate the environment to locate a rose bush, which is a distinctive tall red flower in Minecraft. This task requires no crafting prerequisites or complex domain knowledge — just visual recognition and navigation. It's ideal as a single-task benchmark because success is clearly measurable (the agent gets close enough to observe/face a rose bush block). The scene can be designed with interesting navigation challenges (obstacles, distractors like other flowers) to make it non-trivial while remaining fair.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the rose bush and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the target.' The rose bush is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 4) — target is set to [5, 1, 4] (y=1 targets the upper half of the two-block-tall flower for natural facing calculation). max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated toward the rose bush (spawn distance is ~6.4 blocks, so they must move at least ~1.4 blocks closer). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is oriented toward the rose bush. The sandbox preview confirmed the agent reaches within 3-4 blocks while facing the rose bush by step 10-19, validating these parameters.

scene_description: A flat grass platform with various flowers scattered around and a few structures as landmarks. The rose bush (target) is placed at ~5 ~0 ~4, which is 6.4 blocks from spawn in the positive-X/Z direction. Distractor flowers (dandelion, poppy, blue orchid, oxeye daisy, allium) are scattered in other directions. An oak log column and cobblestone wall provide navigation landmarks.
task_text: Find the rose bush. It is a tall red flower that is two blocks high. Navigate through the area and locate it.
design_notes: Rose bush at ~5 ~0 ~4 (distance ≈ 6.4 from spawn). Poppy moved to ~-4 ~0 ~-3 (opposite direction) to reduce confusion. Oak log at ~3 ~0 ~-2 serves as a landmark near the path to the rose bush. Cobblestone wall at ~-1 ~0 ~6 is a secondary landmark. The scene is open enough that the rose bush is visible from near spawn but requires walking to approach.
